meta.what: Crop or rest each season, seen from NASA satellites, for every field of 40 acres or more in Adams, Lincoln and Whitman counties.
meta.product: HLSL30 v2.0 and HLSS30 v2.0, 30 m, LP DAAC Cumulus
meta.dates: HLS: up to two of the clearest scenes in each of six spans from March to July, 2015 to 2025
meta.bands: NDVI from red B04 and near infrared (B05 Landsat, B8A Sentinel-2); Fmask cloud, next-to-cloud, shadow, snow and water pixels left out
meta.rule: A field's greenness on a scene is the mean NDVI of the 30 m pixels whose centre is inside its outline, when at least half of them are clear. Season peak from March to July over 0.37 is a crop, else rest.
meta.threshold_why: Chosen from the data: of the thresholds 0.30 to 0.50 that keep all 33 years of the three fields traced by hand on HLS right, 0.37 agrees best with the NASA MODIS record. The 164252 field-season peaks have a resting hump near 0.2 and a dryland crop hump near 0.35 to 0.4 (irrigated crops go past 0.8); the low point between the first two is 0.30, which would call the weediest resting years a crop. MODIS used 0.45 on its coarser 250 m squares.
meta.validation: Three fields traced by hand on HLS: 33 of 33 years. The earlier NASA MODIS record (MOD13Q1, 250 m, build_satellite_gibs.py): 149555 of 164164 field-years agree (91.1%).

sources.modis: NASA MODIS (Terra) MOD13Q1, from build_satellite_gibs.py; used only where HLS has no record

meta.format: fields: { id: [acres, bits] or [acres, bits, "h"] }, bits has one character per year from years[0]: 1 crop, 0 rest, - no call. A third item "h" means the record is from HLS; without it, from MODIS.
